# Corbus Pharmaceuticals to Present Late Breaking CRB-913 Data from Canyon-1 Study at Obesity Week® 2026


October 22, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_81b03c3a88320a765846ae643a6df521/corbuspharma/news/2026-10-22_Corbus_Pharmaceuticals_to_Present_Late_Breaking_480.pdf)


NORWOOD, Mass., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRBP), a clinical-stage company focused on new therapies in oncology and obesity, today announced that late breaking data from the CRB-913 Canyon-1 Phase 1B study will be presented as a poster presentation at Obesity Week® 2026, taking place from November 14–17, 2026 in National Harbor, MD.


**Title** **:** Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of CRB-913 in the Ph1b CANYON-1 Study
**Presenter:** Harold Bays, M.D, Louisville Metabolic and Atherosclerosis Research Center
**Date/Time:** November 15, 2026, 2:30 p.m. – 3:30 p.m. ET
**Location:** Gaylord National Resort & Convention Center: Exhibit Hall BCD


**A** **bout Corbus** Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage company focusing on new therapies in oncology and obesity and is committed to helping people defeat serious illness by bringing innovative scientific approaches to well-understood biological pathways. Corbus’ pipeline includes CRB-701, a next-generation antibody drug conjugate for the treatment of Nectin-4-expressing tumors, and CRB-913, an orally delivered highly peripherally restricted CB1 inverse agonist for the treatment of obesity. Corbus is headquartered in Norwood, Massachusetts.
